lines.en: The commit count was frozen at 21.

lines.ko: 방문자 화면이 저마다 직접 숫자를 물어봤습니다.
lines.en: Each visitor's browser was asking for the number directly.
It only answers 60 times an hour, and we hit the cap.
So the screen quietly fell back to last night's value.

lines.ko: 이제 서버가 5분에 한 번 대신 셉니다.
lines.en: Now the server counts once every 5 minutes.
The number on the front page actually moves now.

lines.ko: 올린 뒤에 숫자가 진짜 움직이는지 확인해야 합니다.
lines.en: After pushing, I need to confirm the number really moves.

lines.ko: 커밋 20개 중 제일 오래 붙잡은 숫자였습니다.
lines.en: 20 commits today, and this number took the longest.
lines.art: a worn stopwatch resting beside a stack of paper slips
